================ FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/migrations/behandling.ts ================

import { db } from "@workspace/db";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

/**
 * Additive, repeatable schema/data migration for the shared treatment flow.
 * Kept separate so the startup path and the regression suite exercise the
 * exact same migration.
 */
export async function ensureBehandlingFields() {
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS behandling_typ TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS utforare TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ntr_klass TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS olika_ntr_per_paket BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS kulor TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ncs_ral_kod TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS antal_strykningar INTEGER`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS malade_sidor INTEGER`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE specifikationer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS behandlings_instruktion TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE spec_paket ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ntr_klass TEXT`);

  // Do not infer historical NTR data. Legacy impregnering is explicitly a
  // treatment and its old buyer field remains untouched.
  await db.execute(sql`
    UPDATE specifikationer
    SET behandling_typ = 'IMPREGNERING',
        utforare = CASE
          WHEN utforare IS NULL OR BTRIM(utforare) = '' THEN kund
          ELSE utforare
        END
    WHERE typ = 'impregnering'
      AND (behandling_typ IS NULL OR BTRIM(behandling_typ) = ''
           OR utforare IS NULL OR BTRIM(utforare) = '')
  `);
}

================ FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/migrations/paketlapp.ts ================

import { db } from "@workspace/db";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

/**
 * Additive and repeatable migration for the Paketlapp integration.
 * Existing lager rows receive only nullable metadata columns; no existing
 * values are rewritten.
 */
export async function ensurePaketlappFields() {
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE lager_poster ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS behandling TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE lager_poster ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS utforande TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE lager_poster ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS extern_source_id TEXT`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE lager_poster ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS extern_revision INTEGER`);
  await db.execute(sql`ALTER TABLE lager_poster ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS raderad_at TIMESTAMP`);

  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extern_paket_idempotency (
      id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
      idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      pkt_nr TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      response JSONB NOT NULL,
      skapad_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
    )
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS extern_paket_idempotency_key_unique
      ON extern_paket_idempotency (idempotency_key)
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS extern_paket_idempotency_source_idx
      ON extern_paket_idempotency (source_id)
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS extern_paket_idempotency_pkt_idx
      ON extern_paket_idempotency (pkt_nr)
  `);
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lager_poster_extern_source_idx
      ON lager_poster (extern_source_id)
  `);
}

================ FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/__tests__/allowlistSecurity.test.ts ================

import express, { type NextFunction, type Request, type Response } from "express";
import type { Server } from "node:http";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  transaction: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock("@workspace/db", async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("@workspace/db")>();
  return {
    ...actual,
    db: {
      transaction: mocks.transaction,
    },
  };
});

vi.mock("../../app", () => ({
  requireAdmin: (_req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => next(),
}));

import allowlistRouter from "../allowlist";

let server: Server;
let baseUrl: string;

beforeAll(async () => {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use("/allowlist", allowlistRouter);
  server = app.listen(0);
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.once("listening", resolve));
  const address = server.address();
  if (!address || typeof address === "string") throw new Error("Testservern startade inte");
  baseUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}`;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) =>
    server.close((error) => (error ? reject(error) : resolve())),
  );
});

beforeEach(() => vi.clearAllMocks());

describe("allowlist lifecycle", () => {
  test("sista allowlist-posten kan inte raderas", async () => {
    const deleteWhere = vi.fn();
    mocks.transaction.mockImplementation(async (callback) => {
      let selectCall = 0;
      const tx = {
        execute: vi.fn(),
        select: vi.fn(() => {
          selectCall += 1;
          return selectCall === 1
            ? { from: async () => [{ count: 1 }] }
            : {
                from: () => ({
                  where: () => ({ limit: async () => [{ id: 1 }] }),
                }),
              };
        }),
        delete: vi.fn(() => ({ where: deleteWhere })),
      };
      return callback(tx);
    });

    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/allowlist/user%40example.com`, { method: "DELETE" });

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    expect(deleteWhere).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  test("en post kan raderas när minst en annan post blir kvar", async () => {
    const deleteWhere = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    mocks.transaction.mockImplementation(async (callback) => {
      let selectCall = 0;
      const tx = {
        execute: vi.fn(),
        select: vi.fn(() => {
          selectCall += 1;
          return selectCall === 1
            ? { from: async () => [{ count: 2 }] }
            : {
                from: () => ({
                  where: () => ({ limit: async () => [{ id: 1 }] }),
                }),
              };
        }),
        delete: vi.fn(() => ({ where: deleteWhere })),
      };
      return callback(tx);
    });

    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/allowlist/user%40example.com`, { method: "DELETE" });

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await response.json()).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(deleteWhere).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});

================ FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/__tests__/authorizationSecurity.test.ts ================

import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from "express";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  getAuth: vi.fn(),
  getUser: vi.fn(),
  updateUser: vi.fn(),
  select: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock("@clerk/express", () => ({
  clerkMiddleware: () => (_req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => next(),
  getAuth: mocks.getAuth,
  clerkClient: {
    users: {
      getUser: mocks.getUser,
      updateUser: mocks.updateUser,
    },
  },
}));

vi.mock("@workspace/db", async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("@workspace/db")>();
  return {
    ...actual,
    db: { select: mocks.select },
  };
});

import { requireAuth } from "../../app";

function responseMock() {
  const json = vi.fn();
  const status = vi.fn(() => ({ json }));
  return { response: { status } as unknown as Response, status, json };
}

describe("fail-closed authorization", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mocks.getAuth.mockReturnValue({ userId: "user-1", sessionClaims: {} });
    mocks.getUser.mockResolvedValue({
      publicMetadata: {},
      emailAddresses: [{ emailAddress: "user@example.com" }],
    });
  });

  test("nekar användare utan roll när allowlist inte ger en träff", async () => {
    mocks.select.mockReturnValue({
      from: () => ({
        where: () => ({ limit: async () => [] }),
      }),
    });
    const next = vi.fn() as NextFunction;
    const { response, status, json } = responseMock();

    await requireAuth({} as Request, response, next);

    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(403);
    expect(json).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ error: "access_denied" }));
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mocks.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  test("provisionerar befintlig allowlist-roll och släpper igenom användaren", async () => {
    mocks.select.mockReturnValue({
      from: () => ({
        where: () => ({ limit: async () => [{ rol: "anvandare" }] }),
      }),
    });
    const request = {} as Request & { userId?: string };
    const next = vi.fn() as NextFunction;
    const { response } = responseMock();

    await requireAuth(request, response, next);

    expect(mocks.updateUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith("user-1", {
      publicMetadata: { role: "anvandare" },
    });
    expect(request.userId).toBe("user-1");
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});

================ FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/__tests__/behandlingar.test.ts ================

// Riktad regressionssvit för Behandlingar.
//
// Testerna använder samma säkra testmönster som övriga API-tester: routrar
// monteras direkt utan Clerk, med ett injicerat test-userId. Testdata får
// unika PKT-NR/specar och städas alltid bort efter körningen.
import "../../app";

import express from "express";
import type { Server } from "node:http";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { and, eq, inArray, isNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  db,
  pool,
  lagerHistorikTable,
  lagerPosterTable,
  specifikationerTable,
  specPaketTable,
} from "@workspace/db";
import { iLagerConditions } from "../../lib/lagerFilters";
import { ensureBehandlingFields } from "../../migrations/behandling";
import specRouter from "../spec";
import lagerRouter from "../lager";

type ApiResult<T> = { status: number; data: T };
type TreatmentResponse = {
  id: number;
  behandlingTyp: string | null;
  kund: string | null;
  utforare: string | null;
  ntrKlass: string | null;
  olikaNtrPerPaket: boolean;
  paket?: Array<{ lagerPostId?: number; id: number; ntrKlass: string | null }>;
};

const suffix = `${Date.now()}-${process.pid}`;
const pkt = (name: string) => `TEST-BEH-${suffix}-${name}`;
const specIds: number[] = [];
const postIds: number[] = [];
const historyIds: number[] = [];
let server: Server;
let baseUrl: string;

function buildTestApp() {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use((req, _res, next) => {
    (req as express.Request & { userId?: string }).userId = "behandling-testare";
    next();
  });
  app.use("/spec", specRouter);
  app.use("/lager", lagerRouter);
  return app;
}

async function api<T = unknown>(
  method: string,
  path: string,
  body?: unknown,
): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  return { status: response.status, data: (text ? JSON.parse(text) : null) as T };
}

async function createPost(
  pktNr: string,
  avrappTyp: string | null = null,
  m3 = "1.25",
) {
  const [row] = await db
    .insert(lagerPosterTable)
    .values({
      pktNr: pktNr,
      traslag: "Furu",
      profil: "Regel",
      nomTjocklek: "45",
      nomBredd: "95",
      actTjocklek: "43",
      actBredd: "93",
      langdDm: "48",
      antal: 10,
      lpm: "48",
      m3,
      actM3: "1.18",
      avrappTyp,
    })
    .returning();
  postIds.push(row.id);
  return row;
}

async function createSpec(body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const result = await api<TreatmentResponse>("POST", "/spec", body);
  expect(result.status).toBe(200);
  specIds.push(result.data.id);
  return result.data;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  await ensureBehandlingFields();
  server = buildTestApp().listen(0);
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.once("listening", resolve));
  const address = server.address();
  if (!address || typeof address === "string") throw new Error("Testservern startade inte");
  baseUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}`;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  if (server) {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) =>
      server.close((error) => (error ? reject(error) : resolve())),
    );
  }
  if (historyIds.length) {
    await db.delete(lagerHistorikTable).where(inArray(lagerHistorikTable.id, historyIds));
  }
  if (specIds.length) {
    await db.delete(specifikationerTable).where(inArray(specifikationerTable.id, specIds));
  }
  if (postIds.length) {
    await db.delete(lagerPosterTable).where(inArray(lagerPosterTable.id, postIds));
  }
  await pool.end();
});

describe("Behandlingar — migration och kompatibilitet", () => {
  test("migrerar gammal impregnering två gånger utan att ändra historik eller paket", async () => {
    const legacyPost = await createPost(pkt("legacy"), "hos_impregnerare");
    const legacyPost2 = await createPost(pkt("legacy"), "hos_impregnerare");
    const [legacy] = await db
      .insert(specifikationerTable)
      .values({ typ: "impregnering", kund: `Bitus ${suffix}`, status: "utkast" })
      .returning();
    specIds.push(legacy.id);
    await db.insert(specPaketTable).values([
      { specId: legacy.id, lagerPostId: legacyPost.id },
      { specId: legacy.id, lagerPostId: legacyPost2.id },
    ]);
    const [history] = await db
      .insert(lagerHistorikTable)
      .values({
        lagerId: legacyPost.id,
        action: "behandling_test",
        andringar: JSON.stringify({ preserved: true }),
      })
      .returning();
    historyIds.push(history.id);

    await ensureBehandlingFields();
    await ensureBehandlingFields();

    const [migrated] = await db
      .select()
      .from(specifikationerTable)
      .where(eq(specifikationerTable.id, legacy.id));
    const links = await db
      .select()
      .from(specPaketTable)
      .where(eq(specPaketTable.specId, legacy.id));
    const historyAfter = await db
      .select()
      .from(lagerHistorikTable)
      .where(eq(lagerHistorikTable.id, history.id));

    expect(migrated).toMatchObject({
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "IMPREGNERING",
      kund: `Bitus ${suffix}`,
      utforare: `Bitus ${suffix}`,
      ntrKlass: null,
    });
    expect(links).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(historyAfter).toHaveLength(1);

    const currentLegacy = await db
      .select({ id: lagerPosterTable.id })
      .from(lagerPosterTable)
      .where(and(inArray(lagerPosterTable.id, [legacyPost.id, legacyPost2.id]), ...iLagerConditions()));
    expect(currentLegacy).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

describe("Behandlingar — serverregler och livscykel", () => {
  test("kräver NTR vid bekräftelse och sparar blandad NTR per paketrad", async () => {
    const first = await createPost(pkt("mixed-a"));
    const second = await createPost(pkt("mixed-b"));
    const missing = await createSpec({
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "IMPREGNERING",
      kund: `Missing ${suffix}`,
      paketIds: [first.id],
    });
    const missingConfirmation = await api("POST", `/spec/${missing.id}/bekrafta`);
    expect(missingConfirmation.status).toBe(400);

    const mixed = await createSpec({
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "IMPREGNERING",
      kund: `Mixed ${suffix}`,
      utforare: "Bitus",
      ntrKlass: "NTR_AB",
      olikaNtrPerPaket: true,
      ntrByPaket: {
        [first.id]: "NTR_A",
        [second.id]: "NTR_AB",
      },
      paketIds: [first.id, second.id, second.id],
    });
    const detail = await api<TreatmentResponse>("GET", `/spec/${mixed.id}`);
    expect(detail.status).toBe(200);
    expect(detail.data.paket).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(detail.data.paket?.map((row) => row.ntrKlass)).toEqual(["NTR_A", "NTR_AB"]);

    const collapseWithoutChoice = await api("PUT", `/spec/${mixed.id}`, {
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "IMPREGNERING",
      kund: `Mixed ${suffix}`,
      utforare: "Bitus",
      olikaNtrPerPaket: false,
      paketIds: [first.id, second.id],
    });
    expect(collapseWithoutChoice.status).toBe(400);

    const collapse = await api("PUT", `/spec/${mixed.id}`, {
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "IMPREGNERING",
      kund: `Mixed ${suffix}`,
      utforare: "Bitus",
      ntrKlass: "NTR_A",
      olikaNtrPerPaket: false,
      paketIds: [first.id, second.id],
    });
    expect(collapse.status).toBe(200);
    const collapsed = await api<TreatmentResponse>("GET", `/spec/${mixed.id}`);
    expect(collapsed.data.paket?.map((row) => row.ntrKlass)).toEqual(["NTR_A", "NTR_A"]);
  });

  test("ärver standardklass för nya paket, avvisar NTR på grundmålning och hanterar retur/återöppning", async () => {
    const first = await createPost(pkt("lifecycle-a"));
    const added = await createPost(pkt("lifecycle-b"));
    const treatment = await createSpec({
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "IMPREGNERING",
      ntrKlass: "NTR_AB",
      paketIds: [first.id],
    });
    const addedResult = await api("POST", `/spec/${treatment.id}/paket`, { lagerId: added.id });
    expect(addedResult.status).toBe(200);
    const detail = await api<TreatmentResponse>("GET", `/spec/${treatment.id}`);
    expect(detail.data.paket?.find((row) => row.id === added.id)?.ntrKlass).toBe("NTR_AB");

    const groundWithNtr = await api("POST", "/spec", {
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "GRUNDMALNING",
      kulor: "Vit",
      ntrKlass: "NTR_A",
      paketIds: [first.id],
    });
    expect(groundWithNtr.status).toBe(400);

    const ground = await createSpec({
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "GRUNDMALNING",
      kulor: "Vit",
      ncsRalKod: "RAL 9010",
      antalStrykningar: 2,
      maladeSidor: 4,
      behandlingsInstruktion: "Måla enligt instruktion.",
      paketIds: [],
    });
    const confirm = await api("POST", `/spec/${treatment.id}/bekrafta`);
    expect(confirm.status).toBe(200);
    const endedTypeChange = await api("PUT", `/spec/${treatment.id}`, {
      typ: "impregnering",
      behandlingTyp: "GRUNDMALNING",
      kulor: "Vit",
      paketIds: [first.id, added.id],
    });
    expect(endedTypeChange.status).toBe(400);

    const returned = await api("POST", `/spec/${treatment.id}/returnera`);
    expect(returned.status).toBe(200);
    const [returnedPost] = await db
      .select({ avrappTyp: lagerPosterTable.avrappTyp })
      .from(lagerPosterTable)
      .where(eq(lagerPosterTable.id, first.id));
    expect(returnedPost.avrappTyp).toBeNull();

    const reopened = await api("POST", `/spec/${treatment.id}/ateroppen`);
    expect(reopened.status).toBe(200);
    const [reopenedSpec] = await db
      .select({ status: specifikationerTable.status })
      .from(specifikationerTable)
      .where(eq(specifikationerTable.id, treatment.id));
    expect(reopenedSpec.status).toBe("utkast");
    void ground;
  });

  test("lämnar leverans- och hyvlingsspecifikationers bekräftelsebeteende oförändrat", async () => {
    const deliveryPost = await createPost(pkt("delivery"));
    const planingPost = await createPost(pkt("planing"));
    const delivery = await createSpec({
      typ: "leverans",
      kund: `Leverans ${suffix}`,
      paketIds: [deliveryPost.id],
    });
    const planing = await createSpec({
      typ: "hyvling",
      kund: `Hyvling ${suffix}`,
      paketIds: [planingPost.id],
    });

    expect((await api("POST", `/spec/${delivery.id}/bekrafta`)).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await api("POST", `/spec/${planing.id}/bekrafta`)).status).toBe(200);

    const rows = await db
      .select({
        id: lagerPosterTable.id,
        datumUt: lagerPosterTable.datumUt,
        avrappTyp: lagerPosterTable.avrappTyp,
      })
      .from(lagerPosterTable)
      .where(inArray(lagerPosterTable.id, [deliveryPost.id, planingPost.id]));
    const byId = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
    expect(byId.get(deliveryPost.id)).toMatchObject({
      avrappTyp: "utlevererat",
    });
    expect(byId.get(deliveryPost.id)?.datumUt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(byId.get(planingPost.id)).toMatchObject({
      avrappTyp: "hyvlat_till_lager",
    });
    expect(byId.get(planingPost.id)?.datumUt).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("Behandlingar — fysiska paket och lagerfilter", () => {
  test("returnerar alla aktuella rader för samma fysiska pktNr exakt en gång", async () => {
    const physicalPkt = pkt("physical");
    const first = await createPost(physicalPkt);
    const second = await createPost(physicalPkt);
    const response = await api<{
      rader: Array<{ id: number }>;
      antalRader: number;
    }>("GET", `/lager/paket/${encodeURIComponent(physicalPkt)}`);
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.data.antalRader).toBe(2);
    expect(response.data.rader.map((row) => row.id).sort()).toEqual([first.id, second.id].sort());

    const [legacyExcluded, sharedExcluded] = await Promise.all([
      createPost(pkt("legacy-filter"), "hos_impregnerare"),
      createPost(pkt("shared-filter"), "hos_behandling"),
    ]);
    const current = await db
      .select({ id: lagerPosterTable.id })
      .from(lagerPosterTable)
      .where(and(inArray(lagerPosterTable.id, [legacyExcluded.id, sharedExcluded.id]), ...iLagerConditions()));
    expect(current).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});
